title: Canonical tensor stalk comparison in module coordinates
statement: Let $X\to S$, $X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$ and $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ form a cartesian square [def-pc-base-change]. Let $E,K\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_X)$, $K\prime\in D_{QCoh}(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ [def-pc-derived-category] and $\varphi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$. Let $\tau$ be the canonical derived pullback tensor comparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Fix a point $z\in X\prime$ and any K-flat coordinates $c$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition] of $\tau(E,K);(1\otimes\varphi)$. There are coordinates $d$ of $\varphi$ and a K-flat complex $Q$ over $A=\mathcal O_{X,g\prime z}$. Put $R=\mathcal O_{S,f(g\prime z)}$, $B=\mathcal O_{S\prime,f\prime z}$, $C=\mathcal O_{X\prime,z}$, $P=d.P_{g\prime z}$ and $N=d.N_z$, and let $J$ be scalar extension $A\to C$. Then $P$ is A-K-flat, $C$ is flat over $A\otimes_R B$, and there is the pinned scalar-extension tensor isomorphism $\gamma$ of [lem-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-inheritance]. Let $t:J(P)\to N$ be the actual pullback-stalk isomorphism followed by the stalk of $d.t$, and let $M$ be the recorded cohomology model for $\operatorname{Tot}(Q\otimes_A P)$. In every degree there are isomorphisms $a$ from the source of the c-stalk comparison to the source of the M-localized comparison, and $b$ from $H^i(\operatorname{Tot}(J(Q)\otimes_C N))$ to the target of the c-stalk comparison, such that the c-stalk comparison is $a;M.\mathrm{localizedComparison}^i;H^i(\gamma;\operatorname{Tot}(1\otimes t));b$. No comparison-isomorphism hypothesis on $\varphi$ is used.

proof.text: Choose K-flat representatives of E and K and a K-injective representative of Kprime. Lift phi using the shared counit and its invertibility on a K-flat representative. Apply the K-flat stalk criterion to get the two A-K-flat stalk complexes.

Apply the degreewise pullback-stalk identification to the lifted chain map. Stalks commute with sums and tensor, so totalize the degreewise identifications. The canonical predicate for tau identifies the induced tensor morphism with gamma followed by the total map 1 tensor t.

The fiber-product stalk is a localization of the tensor of the two stalk algebras, hence flat. Compare the constructed coordinates with arbitrary c through common K-flat resolutions; counit naturality and the coefficient-action equations give the source and target isomorphisms a,b and the stated comparison identity.
